caption: Roman bridge and hilltown, Fermignano
composition: Ancient stone bridge arches over the Metauro with hilltown towers rising behind · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the riverbank, the camera frames the ancient stone bridge of Fermignano spanning the calm Metauro in the bright 14:38 afternoon. Three great arches cross the lower frame, their reflections doubling in the still green water, while the hilltown rises behind on the wooded hill with its two bell towers standing out against the blue sky. Lush trees line both banks, and the afternoon sun lights the weathered stone of the bridge.
